categories.description: Accessible names, labels, and assistive-technology text.
User-invoked actions, including button and command labels.
Annotations embedded in previews or generated content.
Legacy misspelling currently used by package.catagories.list; prefer categories for new records.
Extension command titles exposed by the host application.
Parser, server, and workspace diagnostic messages.
Dialog titles, questions, details, and response labels.
Language directives and directive-oriented syntax text.
Section and page headings.
Input placeholders and input-specific guidance.
General informational, warning, and application messages.
Package and application metadata displayed to users.
Product identity and display-name text.
Long-running operation status and progress text.
Generated report titles, headings, and report-oriented text.
Persistent status indicators and status-bar text.
Translation workflow notices and review guidance.
Tree-view headers, nodes, and tree navigation labels.
General interface text not yet assigned to a narrower category.
Prominent warning text outside diagnostic and message flows.
Category inventory and category-selection labels; preferred replacement for catagories.
Application-level behavior, lifecycle, and maintenance operations.
Confirmation questions for consequential or destructive actions.
Guidance shown when a list, table, or result set is empty.
Operation and application failures that are not language diagnostics.
Form-field labels, descriptions, requirements, and field help.
Search, filter, sort, and scope controls.
Explanatory, onboarding, instructional, and contextual help text.
Application, context-menu, and overflow-menu labels.
Navigation destinations, breadcrumbs, tabs, and panel selectors.
Transient notifications, banners, and toast messages.
Questions and instructions that request user input or a decision.
Configuration names, descriptions, choices, and defaults.
Counts, coverage summaries, totals, and compact result overviews.
Table headings, column labels, row labels, and tabular summaries.
Hover help and concise control explanations.
Validation rules, results, errors, warnings, and remediation guidance.
Window, page, panel, and view titles.
Folder and item paths that may need translation. Documents or translated folders.
